description: End-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps. Tests mix natural-language agent steps (agent.act, agent.assert) with locators and assertions. Mobile tests run on iOS simulators, Android emulators, and real phones. Verified agent steps are replayed without model calls until the app changes.
rules: Set up a project with npx e2e init (pnpm: pnpm dlx e2e init, bun: bunx e2e init). It writes e2e.config.ts and an example test, and keeps existing files.
Run tests with npx e2e run (pnpm: pnpm exec e2e run, bun: bunx e2e run). Pass a file path, or file:line for a single test.
Name test files *.e2e.ts. Web tests use the @e2e-dev/web engine and mobile tests the @e2e-dev/mobile engine, set in targets in e2e.config.ts.
Give agent.act one atomic goal per call, then check the result with agent.assert or a locator expect.

Tests without agent steps need no model. For agent steps, set agents.default.model in e2e.config.ts. To use a ChatGPT, Copilot, OpenCode Console or SuperGrok plan, run npx e2e login, then set a model from e2e/oauth/<provider>, like chatgpt('gpt-6-luna').
Verified agent steps are recorded in .e2e/cache/ and replayed with no model calls until the app changes. Add --no-cache to e2e run to skip cached actions.
Run npx e2e guide to print the e2e skill, or npx e2e guide <topic> for one of: setup, writing-tests, agent, running, explore, debugging, mcp, bug-bash.
Run npx e2e doctor to check the config, engines and model before debugging a setup that does not start.
npx e2e mcp starts an MCP server that gives a coding agent a live session on the app under test.
Migration guides from Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, Detox, Maestro and TesterArmy are at https://e2e.com/docs/migrate.
